pages.text: Modules and moving make heat; rain and water shed it faster, the Nether slower. Above 85%% heat, everything works at 70%%; at 100%% the mecha vents for 5 s. Past 60%% load it slows; past 100%%, no jumping; past 125%%, no moving.

$(l)Pilot Warnings$()$(br)$(l)VENTING$(): nothing works, the steam scalds. Wait.$(br)$(l)NO POWER$(): 30%% speed, no arms. Park on the Gantry.$(br)$(l)OVERLOADED$(): unload the hold.$(br)$(l)NO LEGS$(): fit walking legs.
